title: River Cove Residences
description: A waterfront residential development by Sobha Realty on Abu Dhabi's coastline, offering 1 & 2 bedroom apartments with private balconies over landscaped pools and direct water views. Off-plan with a flexible 60/40 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2029.

title: Raw District 2
description: A bold, urban 1-bedroom apartment by Imtiaz Developments on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai's most connected corridor. Raw District 2 pairs an industrial-inspired design language with a full suite of lifestyle amenities — from a residents' library and design lab to curated dining and lounge spaces. Off-plan with a 50/50 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q2 2029.

title: Golf Fields
description: Green living and a connected community by Emaar in Dubai South, wrapped around landscaped golf-course fairways. 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments (priced from the 1-bedroom configuration) with resident pool, BBQ deck, and golf-course views. Off-plan with an 80/20 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q3 2030.

title: Villa Sanctuary
description: A gated townhouse community by Sobha Realty in Dubai Land, offering 4 & 5 bedroom homes across a master-planned neighbourhood with dedicated community pools, formal and family living spaces, and private gardens. Off-plan with a 60/40 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q1 2029.

title: Hills Grove Townhouse
description: A corner-plot townhouse in Dubai Hills Estate's Park Collection, backing onto a community park with direct pedestrian access to the boulevard's schools, clinics and retail. Four ensuite bedrooms plus a maid's room, with a private garden and double garage.

title: Islands 2
description: A lagoon-front community by DAMAC in Damac Islands, offering 4 & 5 bedroom homes wrapped around crystal lagoons, floating amenities and landscaped waterways. Off-plan with a 50/50 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2029.

title: Rise By Athlon
description: Premium 3-bedroom apartments by Aldar Properties in Dubai Land, designed for a life of comfort and elegance. Rise By Athlon pairs a lakefront setting with a full amenity suite — pool, gym, kids' play area and a striking branded lobby. Off-plan with a 40/60 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2029.

title: Arabian Ranches Courtyard Villa
description: A Spanish-Mediterranean style villa set around a private courtyard, in one of Dubai's original and most established villa communities. Mature landscaping, a dedicated golf course, and a strong school catchment make Arabian Ranches a consistent favourite with families.

title: Marina Sky Penthouse
description: A duplex penthouse crowning one of Dubai Marina's tallest towers, with a private rooftop terrace, plunge pool, and 270-degree views spanning the marina skyline to the Palm. Double-height living space and a private elevator lobby complete the offering.

title: Creek Harbour Waterside Townhouse
description: Three-storey waterside townhouses under construction along Dubai Creek Harbour's canal district, on track for a Q3 2026 handover. Each unit includes a private rooftop terrace and direct canal-walk access.

title: Business Bay Executive Tower
description: A design-led two-bedroom residence in a boutique Ellington tower overlooking the Dubai Water Canal, finished with the developer's signature warm materiality and joinery detail rarely seen at this price point.

title: Hills Estate Golf Mansion
description: An ultra-luxury six-bedroom mansion fronting the Dubai Hills 18-hole championship course, offered off-plan with an 80/20 payment structure. Full customisation of interior finishes is available for early reservations.

title: JVC Boulevard Residences
description: A handed-over two-bedroom residence on JVC's central boulevard, already tenanted with a strong rental history — ideal for investors seeking immediate, income-producing stock without an off-plan wait.

title: Palm Garden Homes
description: Low-rise beachfront apartments on the Palm's East Crescent, designed around private podium gardens and direct beach access. A rare low-density offering on an island now largely built out with high-rise towers.
